summary: Make background-only automatic execution a mandatory, non-waivable EKODI constitutional rule across API checks, browser automation, remote-computer execution, isolated execution and future equivalent agent paths.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly instructed EKODI to make the completed background automatic-execution behavior a forced EKODI execution rule and to continue through full implementation, verification and governed release.
implementation: CI hard gates in scripts/validate-constitution.mjs and scripts/validate-virtualization-routing.mjs
contract coverage in test/automatic-execution-constitution.test.mjs and existing Hybrid Execution tests
mandatoryRules: automatic execution never creates or hijacks user-owned browser tabs or interactive desktop surfaces
EKODI-owned temporary automation surfaces auto-close on completion and terminal boundaries
AUTH_REQUIRED is recorded and closes the EKODI-owned surface without automatic interactive login
user-owned windows and tabs are preserved
background API checks are preferred over browser automation for machine-readable checks
foreground is limited to explicit human-required OAuth/provider consent, CAPTCHA/human verification, hardware-backed authentication or OS privileged consent
service-local, agent-local, provider-local, workspace-local and learning-loop waivers are forbidden
rollback: Revert constitution v1.26.0 and its automatic-execution lifecycle policy/config bindings to v1.25.0 while preserving the already-deployed runtime safety behavior until the owner explicitly authorizes a replacement constitutional rule.
